name: Can I replace a bathtub myself, or should I hire a contractor?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace a bathtub myself, or should I hire a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A tub replacement can be DIY-friendly only when the homeowner has the skills, tools, access, and time to manage demolition, plumbing, leveling, waterproofing, and finish repairs. A professional is the safer choice when the tub is heavy, plumbing will move, walls must open, leaks exist, or the work involves several trades.

Context: The visible installation is only part of the project. Errors in slope, support, waterproofing, or waste connections can cause leaks that remain hidden until finishes are complete.

Key factors:
- Plumbing and waterproofing experience
- Tub weight and removal route
- Ability to protect and repair surrounding finishes
- Permit or inspection questions for the specific property

Practical guidance: Obtain an itemized professional scope even if you may do some preparation yourself. In San Diego, permit treatment can depend on the exact work; city guidance distinguishes certain like-for-like tub replacements from projects involving alterations or other work.

Elite Remodeling & Design can manage design, construction coordination, and inspection-related steps when the project exceeds a simple replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY may be reasonable for experienced homeowners handling a simple, accessible swap, but plumbing, waterproofing, heavy demolition, leaks, or layout changes raise the risk. In San Diego, permit treatment depends on the work; confirm the project scope before starting and obtain a professional estimate for comparison.
